source.title: WCA Regulations — May 2021
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WRC would like to inform you about the versions of the WCA Regulations and Guidelines, which are going into effect May 1, 2021.

You can review all changes in [this comparison on GitHub](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/compare/official-2020-08-01...official-2021-05-01). You can click on “Files changed” to see the complete files of the Regulation and Guidelines, where all changes and additions are marked green and removals are red.

**Simplifications**

* Remove Guidelines 2c1+ and 2c1++ which are already in the WCRP. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/af20ca47b1f1d39e8038006d64fb3b6924762671) | [discussion](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/2c1-and-2c1-are-already-in-the-wcrp/1288))
* Remove Guideline 7d+ from the Guidelines. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/9fa1a12759c539aa72d8da04e6b18268f3efda3a) | [discussion](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/remove-7d-and-add-it-to-a-policy/3117))
* Renaming "Competitors Area" to “Competitor Waiting Area”. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/c7799f53ac9b970f04a9a87d5c651d48b0c37022) | [discussion](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/defining-competitors-area-competitor-waiting-area-and-competition-area/7226))

**Accountability**

* The competitor must have no physical contact with the puzzle cover while starting the attempt on Blindfolded events. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/f8deb1995dd7b3d8b1f04ff5eab51c1185ba149f) | [discussion](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/wording-change-for-b2c/3136))
* Modify A2b1 and F2a to not strictly require an announcement. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/2c6e26ab48dfae40184094eb5af3737d4c8393b4) | [discussion](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/modify-a2b1-and-f2a-to-not-require-an-announcement/1291))
* Require the competitor to finish signing (not just for the judge to finish signing) before the competitor may reset the timer. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/942e81b04c9629d03948788ffa3842b44c745dac) | [commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/e103d34066fa51c4a80922db9ad478bcc211c0c6) | [discussion](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/require-the-competitor-to-finish-signing-not-just-for-the-judge-to-finish-signing-before-the-competitor-may-reset-the-timer/1302))
* The competitor may align the faces in Blindfolded events. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/93f6ffc1e39339412c4fe612facf8d0597fed6a2) | [discussion](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/issue-with-section-b3/5175))
* Clarification regarding Guideline A7c4+ use. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/0d675709908751c8f88296f4aaee5d02bf811b18) | [discussion](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/guideline-a7c4-is-imprecise/8764))

**Miscellaneous**

* Remove Article 6 from the Guidelines. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/6310d732aefdf24ab5b20b8710e32f32e3446341) | [discussion](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/remove-article-6-from-the-guidelines/3294))
* Allow for competitors to optionally use a self-supplied “surface” in Multi Blind. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/26c26ac06c3dc35f066e41fc0fe697015b1d3b12) | [discussion](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/allow-for-competitors-to-optionally-use-a-self-supplied-surface-in-mbld/1299))
* The competitor may use correction materials for Fewest Moves. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/3623349980b72f1577590cb5f89850d403d0088f) | [discussion](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/making-e3a-less-strict/1297))
* Clarification regarding competitions requirements. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/998/commits/e993ec9fc1598f397a4bfe2eb8a71af6f0e20072) | [commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1009/files) | [discussion](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/inaccuracy-of-regulation-9k/8926))
* Clarification regarding competitors wearing a smartphone on their pockets. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/1967a18d0f015f6d6aec3fc56d97c1edebe05cfc) | [discussion](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/when-does-2i-apply-exactly-and-other-comment/3203))
* Removing the Regulation Y7e1. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/b8d64a73b98a018bd6f0a12e15e26dc7fa892117))

**Incidents Rulings**

* Multi Blind puzzles are individually penalized if the competitor applies a move during the memorization phase. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/1ad0d119c68f456531ed7aeab81c0adaa32385d7) | [commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/ba7a6a57fb64522053c19cce6b8a0f918058f6ba) | [discussion](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/disqualify-individual-multi-blind-puzzles-if-a-competitor-makes-a-move/3142) | [incident log](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/26))
* Regulation A6e) revisement. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/5e16272b1ce494df25429bda8bf476174c2770b8) | [commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/f0673fc82837fbab9e7c66b5e123c00c5e2b1d8c) | [discussion](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/regulation-a6e-revisement/3225) | [incident log](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/23))
* Clarification regarding advancement conditions. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/15b9400069d54dabb9091b8fe307eb40ec90f8f9) | [commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/ae15de6a8bfa7c9394ba170b901406eae5d4be0e) | [commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/219709f9511e5dd64163cc0ba6d255f8ada1e487) | [discussion](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/incidents-resulting-in-fewer-competitors-advancing/3272) | [incident log](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/56))
* Clarification regarding how disqualifications results should be handled. ([commit](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/1f8ff6d71cbb90cc49e1ea368736c5237edd6393) | [incident log](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/58))

translation.title: WCA 规则更新：2021 年 5 月
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

WRC 在此介绍将于 2021 年 5 月 1 日生效的新版《WCA 规则与指南》。

全部改动可通过 [GitHub 上的对比](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/compare/official-2020-08-01...official-2021-05-01)查看。点击“Files changed”即可查看《规则》和《指南》的完整文件；修改和新增内容标为绿色，删除内容标为红色。

**简化条文**

* 删除已包含在《WCA 比赛要求政策》中的指南 2c1+ 和 2c1++。 ([提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/af20ca47b1f1d39e8038006d64fb3b6924762671) | [讨论](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/2c1-and-2c1-are-already-in-the-wcrp/1288))
* 删除指南 7d+。 ([提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/9fa1a12759c539aa72d8da04e6b18268f3efda3a) | [讨论](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/remove-7d-and-add-it-to-a-policy/3117))
* 将“选手区”更名为“选手等候区”。 ([提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/c7799f53ac9b970f04a9a87d5c651d48b0c37022) | [讨论](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/defining-competitors-area-competitor-waiting-area-and-competition-area/7226))

**明确责任**

* 在盲拧项目中，选手开始还原尝试时，身体不得接触魔方罩。 ([提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/f8deb1995dd7b3d8b1f04ff5eab51c1185ba149f) | [讨论](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/wording-change-for-b2c/3136))
* 修改 A2b1 和 F2a，不再严格要求口头告知。 ([提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/2c6e26ab48dfae40184094eb5af3737d4c8393b4) | [讨论](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/modify-a2b1-and-f2a-to-not-require-an-announcement/1291))
* 要求选手必须在自己签字完成后才可复位计时器，而不只是等裁判签完字。 ([提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/942e81b04c9629d03948788ffa3842b44c745dac) | [提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/e103d34066fa51c4a80922db9ad478bcc211c0c6) | [讨论](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/require-the-competitor-to-finish-signing-not-just-for-the-judge-to-finish-signing-before-the-competitor-may-reset-the-timer/1302))
* 允许选手在盲拧项目中对齐各面。 ([提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/93f6ffc1e39339412c4fe612facf8d0597fed6a2) | [讨论](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/issue-with-section-b3/5175))
* 明确指南 A7c4+ 的适用方式。 ([提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/0d675709908751c8f88296f4aaee5d02bf811b18) | [讨论](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/guideline-a7c4-is-imprecise/8764))

**其他调整**

* 删除《指南》第 6 章。 ([提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/6310d732aefdf24ab5b20b8710e32f32e3446341) | [讨论](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/remove-article-6-from-the-guidelines/3294))
* 允许选手在三阶多盲中自行选择使用自备的垫面。 ([提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/26c26ac06c3dc35f066e41fc0fe697015b1d3b12) | [讨论](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/allow-for-competitors-to-optionally-use-a-self-supplied-surface-in-mbld/1299))
* 允许选手在最少步比赛中使用涂改用品。 ([提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/3623349980b72f1577590cb5f89850d403d0088f) | [讨论](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/making-e3a-less-strict/1297))
* 明确比赛要求。 ([提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/998/commits/e993ec9fc1598f397a4bfe2eb8a71af6f0e20072) | [提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1009/files) | [讨论](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/inaccuracy-of-regulation-9k/8926))
* 明确选手将智能手机放在口袋中的相关规定。 ([提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/1967a18d0f015f6d6aec3fc56d97c1edebe05cfc) | [讨论](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/when-does-2i-apply-exactly-and-other-comment/3203))
* 删除规则 Y7e1。 ([提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/b8d64a73b98a018bd6f0a12e15e26dc7fa892117))

**意外事件裁定**

* 在三阶多盲记忆阶段，如果选手转动魔方，对涉及的魔方单独处罚。 ([提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/1ad0d119c68f456531ed7aeab81c0adaa32385d7) | [提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/ba7a6a57fb64522053c19cce6b8a0f918058f6ba) | [讨论](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/disqualify-individual-multi-blind-puzzles-if-a-competitor-makes-a-move/3142) | [意外事件日志](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/26))
* 修订规则 A6e)。 ([提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/5e16272b1ce494df25429bda8bf476174c2770b8) | [提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/f0673fc82837fbab9e7c66b5e123c00c5e2b1d8c) | [讨论](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/regulation-a6e-revisement/3225) | [意外事件日志](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/23))
* 明确晋级条件。 ([提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/15b9400069d54dabb9091b8fe307eb40ec90f8f9) | [提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/ae15de6a8bfa7c9394ba170b901406eae5d4be0e) | [提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/219709f9511e5dd64163cc0ba6d255f8ada1e487) | [讨论](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/incidents-resulting-in-fewer-competitors-advancing/3272) | [意外事件日志](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/56))
* 明确被取消资格的成绩应如何处理。 ([提交](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/commit/1f8ff6d71cbb90cc49e1ea368736c5237edd6393) | [意外事件日志](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/incidents/58))
